awesome-ai-companion（Memory & Identity）.desc: General agent memory server: LLM fact extraction, four-way recall (vector, BM25, entity graph, time), evidence-backed observations refined over time, per-bank MCP. MIT; paid Cloud optional. `Python` · `Self-host` · `infra`.
